Personal Information Name: Sai Swaroop Kooderu, Bachelor of Technology Address: 104, Casa Crimson, Kelekare, Bangalore, India Phone: +91- 8804488055 Email: It.swaroops@gmail.com Date of Birth: 06.08.1985 Place of Birth: India

Profile An enthusiastic, highly approachable & professional offering expertise as a “Agile Project Manager” experience (More than 15yrs) looking for a challenging role and open to adapt to new technologies and work in challenging roles to utilize the acquired expertise for the benefit of the organization and the customer.

Skills ● Technical: Sound knowledge on Agile Project Management, Account Management, Scrum etc ● Concepts: Account Management, Strategic thinking & Planning, Strong banking domain knowledge, Client Management, Effective Customer communication, Strong people management, Report Generation ● Testing: Unit, Sanity Testing, SIT, UAT, Regression ● Tools & Frameworks: ALM, RTC, JIRA, Clarity, MS excel, Power Point ● Databases: SQL ● Operating Systems: Windows ● Languages: English (Fluent)

Professional Experience

Thakral One

Duration: 5 months

Role: Sr. Project Manager - Enterprise Project Management – Mitsubishi Global Serviced, Japan

Worked with Process Experts / Process Excellence Team, IT Advisors and Product owners for streamlined delivery Requirements.

Well versed in designing solution & effort estimations. • Coordinate with change management & Release management teams. • Worked with Stakeholders in requirement gathering & supported Bas to convert them in to solution requirement i.e. BRD, FRD Contributed to the development of the Functional Specifications from a technical

ITC Infotech

Duration: 15 years

Role: Sr. Project Manager - Project Management - Saudi National Bank, Saudi

Duration: 10 yrs

Worked with Process Experts / Process Excellence Team, IT Advisors and Product owners for streamlined delivery Requirements.

16+ years of experience in Banking and Financial Services with strong expertise in Payments, Cards, SWIFT, ISO 20022, ISO 8583, NEFT, RTGS, Reconciliation, and payment message processing.

Well versed in designing solution & effort estimations. • Coordinate with change management & Release management teams. • Worked with Stakeholders in requirement gathering & supported Bas to convert them in to solution requirement i.e. BRD, FRD Contributed to the development of the Functional Specifications from a technical

Worked closely with Design Leads and Application Delivery Leads to ensure that new requirements are understood and applied in new work items.Strong understanding of ISO 20022 payment messaging standards and migration from legacy MT/IFTAS/SFMS messaging formats to MX/ISO 20022 standards across payment, trade finance, and cash management systems Hands-on experience in NEFT, RTGS, SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT199, MT191, MT192, and ISO 20022 messages such as pacs.008, pacs.009, pacs.002, camt.056, camt.029, and pain.001. Supported in the resolution of Production issues in meetings with Support Organization. Strong understanding of the end-to-end flow of RTGS and NEFT transactions including: Customer Initiation, Branch Validation, Core Banking System Processing, SFMS/RTGS message generation, RBI Settlement, Beneficiary Bank Acknowledgement, Final Credit Confirmation. Led multiple payment and reconciliation projects involving SWIFT, RTGS, NEFT-equivalent payment processing, and ISO 20022 message analysis.









Conducted workshops with stakeholders to gather requirements related to payment processing, settlement, message validation, and reconciliation.

Created detailed BRD, FRD, use cases, message flow diagrams, and functional specifications. • Analyzed existing payment message formats and supported migration planning toward ISO 20022 compliant structures.

Worked extensively on SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT199 and mapped them to ISO 20022 messages.

• Performed review checks on Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and support User queries on User

Acceptance Testing as needed.

Helped Business Analyst in creating design documents and participated document reviews. • Ability to convert the business requirements into technical requirements. • Handling experience of multi-skilled teams (Business, Developers, Testers, Change management team

and other stakeholders) Ensuring goals are met in areas including customer satisfaction, safety, quality and team members performance Implementing and managing changes and interventions to ensure project goals are achieved



• Producing accurate and timely reporting of program status throughout its life cycle. • Analyzing program risks and prepare mitigating plans. •

Experience in writing business requirements documents (BRD), Analyzing and documenting functional requirements (FSD).

Collaborate with key stakeholders to identify business needs and translate them into functional requirements, ensuring alignment with project goals.

Work closely with Section managers and development teams to ensure timely delivery of technical solutions.

Coordinated between cross-functional teams to ensure integration with existing systems. • Worked on Regulatory, Core banking, Credit cards, Retail Ops, Payment Ops, RPA etc related change

requests. Strong domain knowledge on Islamic Bank Asset products like Auto Finance, Personal Finance, Residential Finance, Core banking, Branch Banking, Credit cards etc. Sound knowledge on Islamic loans. Engage with business, operations, support and IT teams to establish business requirements, perform analysis of the data, mapping of the data to an archive model. • Perform Gap Analysis and Impact assessment of any changes. • Has the ability to create/manage JIRA’s (Epic, Sprint, User Stories, work flows, Dashboards etc..) • Managed user acceptance testing (UAT), ensuring solutions met business requirements before







deployment.

Role: Test Manager/Lead – Santander Bank UK

Duration: 5 yrs

Managed Onsite and Offshore test factories. • Managing Production Incidents. • Resource planning and management. •

Interacting with Business users to understand the requirements and cascade to onsite and offshore teams.

Responsible for timeline estimations and delivery dates. Interaction with Dev Teams during defect triage calls. • • Coordination with Change Control and DBA teams for SIT patch deployment and production deployments.

Coordination with IT delivery leads to fast track the issues and incorporate new changes if any. • Coordination for SIT and regression during release cycles. • Coordination of Production deployment of changes and sanity in production. • Performed requirement feasibility analysis and identified test scenarios/test cases. • Preparation of defect management tracker and traceability matrix. • Defect management using RTC and ALM. • Preparation of daily reports – Test execution and defects.

S. No 1

Client Mitsubishi Global Services, Japan

2

Saudi National Bank, Saudi

3

Santander Bank UK

Certified Professional Scrum Master. • Certified Product Owner.

Role Project Manager - Mortgages, Loan Processing Applications, Corporate Loans Project Manager – Core Banking, Retail Banking, Payment Ops/Screening, Customer Care, ATM Ops, Retail/Payment Ops – Core Banking(TCS Bancs) Test Manager/Lead – Faster Payments, Mortgage Retention, Loan Processing Applications – AIP – FMA and MRS

CERTIFICATIONS
